hero.title: Tech Artist & 3D Artist
hero.subtitle: Crafting digital worlds, one polygon at a time.

about.title: Hello!
about.subtitle: My name is Marcin. I've been working professionally with 3D graphics for over 17 years. I specialize in 3D graphics. If you'd like to learn more about my specific areas, please click the button below and check out my portfolio!

description-more.01: I graduated from the University of Information Technology and Management in Rzeszów, where I majored in Computer Graphics and Animation, and completed postgraduate studies in Software Engineering. This combination allows me to move freely between the artistic and technical worlds.
description-more.02: For a long time, I worked as a freelancer, collaborating on a variety of projects—from 3D visualizations and animations to elements used in games and interactive applications. I'm most comfortable with the role of a Tech Artist. I enjoy creating 3D models with an emphasis on: clean and optimized topology, attention to detail, and proper asset preparation for subsequent production stages.
description-more.04: Proficiency levels are presented as simple graphs. This is a subjective assessment of my experience and comfort with the software, not a rigid percentage—learning in 3D never ends.
